_comment: ironkeep round-3 runtime config (Codex try 1); collision hand-traced per object, no foreground layer.

exit.note: toX/toY = overworld exit cell from exits.json (tools/apply_exits.py), not maps.ts.

npcs.cellNote: 2026-11-27 (design review T4): she stood in the middle of the street, 48 px deep, and a body's space round her closed it. She now stands on her own doorstep, 1.1 cells east and 1.8 north, like Frostwatch's healer; the street is open below her and the hero stops a body away.
npcs.name: Healer
npcs.text: Welcome to the clinic! I can heal your wounds.

npcs.spacePlugNote: 2026-11-27 (FT2, review of the town changes): his space ended 7 px short of the wall east of him, a slit 12 px long; the way round (west of him) is open. Closed.
npcs.name: Soldier
npcs.text: Fierce winds howl through the mountain pass to the north. No one can get through! Maybe if someone stopped whatever is causing those storms...

npcs.spaceNote: 2026-11-27 (design review T4): he stands in the middle of the forge street, 36 px deep, in front of the quench trough (a step back would stand him on the trough). A full body's space closed the street, so his `space` ends 10 px south of his feet and `spaceAlso` is the body he had before (10 px round, 7 px south): from either side the hero stops a body away, below him she comes no nearer than she did, and passing there her sprite still overlaps his by up to `spaceMax` px.
npcs.cellNote: 2026-11-27 (FT2, review of the town changes): 5 px (0.34 cells) back, to the foot of the quench trough: under the round body of before the street was 3 to 4 px wide at one point; it is 8 px now.
npcs.name: Blacksmith
npcs.text: The Iron Mine is southwest of town. And that Storm Nest to the east? The harpy there controls the winds blocking the mountain pass.

npcs.name: Gordo
npcs.text: Welcome to my forge! I'm Gordo, the finest blacksmith in all four lands. If you need weapons or armor, you've come to the right place!

npcs._note: behind the painted counter; the hero talks across it from shopCounter
npcs.name: Shopkeeper
npcs.text: Welcome to my shop! Take a look around.
